messages.author: 89753235781499cd
messages.subject: Smoothers with interactions - coding issue
parts:
Hello,

I am trying to run a ZIP model in inla that has smoothers with interactions (e.g. smoother for week of year that has an interaction with site).

The model below is crashing. I've tried with a subset to check its not a memory issue.

I've also built the model step by step, so have a working model that includes inetractions but no smoothers, and another that has smoothers but no interactions. It seems to be this next step to smoothers with interactions that is causing the issue so perhaps it is my coding?

Any advice would be much apprecaited,
Suzanne


f5 <- hpDPM ~ TimeLost.std + Angle.std + Nall.std + dolDPM.std + dist.std + Serial + Year*Site +
  f(woy.std, Site,  model = "rw2", cyclic=TRUE, hyper = hyper.prec) +
  f(Sdiel.std, Site, model = "rw2", cyclic=TRUE, hyper = hyper.prec)

I5 <- inla(f5,  control.predictor = list(  compute = TRUE,
  quantiles = c(0.025, 0.975)),
  control.compute = list(config = TRUE,dic = TRUE),
  family = "zeroinflatedpoisson0",
  data = dat, verbose=TRUE, control.inla = list(int.strategy="eb"))

messages.subject: Re: Smoothers with interactions - coding issue
parts:
Hi Suzanne,

If you are looking to have a separate smooth per site, consider the 'group' and 'replicate' options for the rw2 effects: https://groups.google.com/g/r-inla-discussion-group/c/W4nTB8h1ZAY/m/31D3FaTpAgAJ

Best,
Tim

parts:
f(woy.std, Site, model = "rw2", cyclic=TRUE, hyper = hyper.prec) +
f(Sdiel.std, Site, model = "rw2", cyclic=TRUE, hyper = hyper.prec)

where the second argument, is not numeric,

> str(dat$Site)
chr [1:256898] "Tolsta" "Tolsta" "Tolsta" "Tolsta" "Tolsta" "Tolsta"
...

its a scaling term, hence it needs to be numeric.

this causes NAN to propate through the calculations and nothing make
sense

best
H
